subject: gk
question: Fundamental duties were first added by which Constitutional Amendment Act ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**42nd Constitutional Amendment Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Fundamental Duties were introduced to the Indian Constitution by the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act in 1976**.
 
• This amendment added **Article 51A** under Part IVA of the Constitution, listing the Fundamental Duties of citizens.
 
• It was implemented during the tenure of Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi** as part of the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.
 
• Initially, **10 Fundamental Duties** were listed, which were later increased to 11 by the **86th Constitutional Amendment Act in 2002**.
 
• The objective of Fundamental Duties is to remind citizens of their moral obligations towards the nation and promote a sense of discipline and commitment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act:**

 
 
• Known as the "Mini Constitution" due to the significant changes it brought to the Indian Constitution.
 
• It amended various aspects, including the Preamble, Fundamental Rights, and Directive Principles of State Policy.
 
• Introduced terms like "Socialist" and "Secular" in the Preamble to emphasize India's commitment to these principles.
 
• Strengthened the central government by curbing the powers of the state governments.
 
 
 
• **Fundamental Duties:**
 
 
• Inspired by the Constitution of the Soviet Union, they aim to inculcate civic responsibility among citizens.
 
• They include duties like respecting national symbols, safeguarding public property, and promoting harmony.
 
• Unlike Fundamental Rights, Fundamental Duties are non-justiciable, meaning they cannot be enforced through courts.
 
 
 
• **Swaran Singh Committee:**
 
 
• Formed in 1976 to study and recommend constitutional amendments.
 
• Proposed the inclusion of Fundamental Duties to instill patriotism and responsibility among citizens.
 
• Its recommendations laid the foundation for the 42nd Amendment Act.
 
 
 
• **86th Constitutional Amendment Act:**
 
 
• Passed in 2002, it added the 11th Fundamental Duty, which mandates parents to provide opportunities for education to their children aged 6-14 years.
 
• This amendment is closely related to the Right to Education Act, 2009.
